component.name: Privacy Panel
component.summary: See and change the privacy settings of your apps

description.p: Privacy Panel finds the privacy settings of the apps on a Linux computer, shows them in one place and lets you change them one by one, per app, or all at once. Every change is recorded and can be undone.

ul.li: KDE Plasma, KDE Connect, GNOME and GTK settings
Firefox, LibreWolf, Floorp, Waterfox, Zen, Thunderbird, Brave, Chrome, Chromium, Vivaldi, Edge and Opera, per profile
Apps such as VLC, LibreOffice, GIMP, Audacity, Transmission, Heroic, FileZilla and VS Code
Desktop portal permissions, Flatpak sandbox permissions and Snap connections
System services, NetworkManager, system logs and distribution telemetry (with the administrator password)

description.p: Privacy Panel only reads settings on this computer. It sends nothing anywhere.
